<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:6">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ</cite> <he>ר״י מטתיה כן</he> such (disease) befell R. J.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:5">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> <he>הוה ליה כן</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:5">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>ימות ולא כן</he> let him rather die than do this (idolatrous cure); a. fr.—

Y. Ber. III, 6ᵇ top לָכֵן דאתינן (v. preced.) it is for this purpose that we came here (to be reminded of death).—דִּל כֵּן, דִּלָכֵן, v. דִּל.—כל דכן, v. כּוֹל.—כֵּינִי = כין הי it is so; (interrog.) is it so, indeed? Y. Peah II, 17ᵃ bot. וכ׳ אלא כ׳ is that so? (No,) but it is thus. Ib. III, 17ᶜ top כ׳ (insert מתניתא); ib. II, beg. 16ᵈ כ׳ מתניתא (not ב׳) so is the Mishnah to be read. Y. B. Mets. III, beg. 9ᵃ וְאִין כ׳ but if this be so; a. fr.
